title: Ypsomed
summary: Swiss maker of self-injection pens and diabetes infusion systems.
bodyHtml:
Investment Thesis

Ypsomed makes autoinjectors, pen injectors and insulin pumps, and supplies device platforms to pharmaceutical companies launching GLP-1 and other self-administered therapies. Its devices are customised per drug and manufactured in Switzerland. Device programme wins drive growth.

Technology Exposure

  • Autoinjectors and pen injectors
  • Insulin pumps and infusion sets
  • Contract device development

What To Watch

  • GLP-1 device contracts
  • Capacity expansion
  • Customer concentration

Record Notes

Editorial brief compiled 19 November 2026 from company disclosures, agency publications and press reporting. Figures are as reported by those sources and have not been independently audited; no live market data is used.
